title: Prussian school system designed for control

tellings.quote:
Because it was the Prussian miracle. So,
they sent people from all How did you
get such control over your citizens?

plain: A guest named Kurt Metzger, talking on a podcast, says the school system of Prussia, an old German state, was seen as a "miracle" for how well it controlled its citizens. As he tells it, other countries sent people over to ask how Prussia managed it and then copied the model, which he links to the United States. If true, it would mean modern schooling was built partly to make people easy to control.
